scope: Proposition 3.5 (Euclidean stability on a component) of the manuscript “The critical dimension for one-phase Bernoulli minimizers” (preprints/The-critical-dimension-for-one-phase-Bernoulli-minimizers-September-24-2026/The-critical-dimension-for-one-phase-Bernoulli-minimizers-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 367 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eb1a535a1d8a9dc4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let D be the selected positivity component of a global minimizing cone in Rm+1. Let ϕ be any real smooth function up to the regular boundary of D, with compact support in that regular closure away from the vertex and from any other singular points. Then Z D |∇ϕ|2 dx ≥ Z ∂D HEϕ2 dσE, HE = −D2 u(NE, NE), (3.19) where NE is the inward Euclidean unit normal. No restriction is imposed on the boundary trace or normal derivative of ϕ.
